hints.title: Operation Ordering
hints.text: If we decide to set k elements to zero at times 1 through k, the element with the larger slope nums2 should be cleared as late as possible.

hints.title: Sorted DP State
hints.text: Sort the elements by nums2 ascending. Now any chosen subset of size j should be reset in that sorted order at seconds 1 through j.

hints.title: Reduction Subtraction
hints.text: Let dp[j] be the maximum reduction achievable by picking j elements. The total sum at time t is initial_sum + t * sum_nums2 - dp[t].

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting by slope followed by 1D 0/1 knapsack dynamic programming.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all 2^n subsets or orderings leads to combinatorial explosion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) DP array space suffices by traversing backwards.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Establish the greedy ordering invariant before applying 0/1 knapsack dynamic programming.
